record.question: Which statement is incorrect regarding the physiological function of Thyroid hormone?
options: Increases basal rate of oxygen consumption
record.explanation: Answer C: Increase in Diastolic blood pressure. Thyroid hormone increases cardiac output and systolic pressure; it tends to lower systemic vascular resistance and diastolic pressure, making “increase in diastolic blood pressure” the incorrect statement among these choices. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK519566/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
